title: [LOGGED OUT] Header "Reward chain" scrolls to the Rewards Market

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store/ and wait until loaded.
steps.saw: Store page loaded, cookie banner visible

steps.text: If a cookie banner is shown, click Dismiss.
Click Reward chain in the header.
steps.saw: Page scrolled to Rewards Market, Reward chain highlighted

steps.text: Is the Rewards Market section shown on the screen?
steps.saw: Rewards Market heading and banner on screen

steps.text: Does it show the text "Make purchases, earn Store points, and claim cool rewards!"?
steps.saw: Text shown: 'Make purchases, earn Store points, and claim cool rewards! More purchases mean more Store points. Gotta claim them all!'

steps.text: Does it show "0/500 points" and "Step 1 of 10"?
Is a row of reward cards with point costs shown?
Is a green "Login to claim" button shown?
steps.saw: Green 'Login to claim' button below the cards
